When a customer abandons checkout, their seats are held only temporarily: the seat hold expires after 10 minutes of unpaid inactivity, at which point tide-worker (scanning every 30 seconds) releases the seats back to inventory and invalidates the event page cache; if a late payment confirmation arrives for an already-lapsed hold, it's automatically refunded.

Sources: tidewater/plans/2026-04-01-hold-release-worker.md, tidewater/memory/glossary.md

This confirms the hold mechanism used in checkout. The glossary note already explains the expiry behavior clearly.

When a customer abandons checkout, the seat hold created for that purchase simply expires after 10 minutes without payment completion, releasing the seats back into inventory for other buyers.

Sources: tidewater/memory/glossary.md, tidewater/plans/2026-01-25-checkout-flow.md
